Specification: A module containing formal TLA+ proofs for fundamental graph reachability lemmas. It establishes properties such as node inclusion in reachable sets, reachability across set unions, and state transitions involving successor nodes using mathematical induction and structured proof steps.
AssumeProveBlocks: SUFFICES ASSUME NEW S \in SUBSET Nodes, NEW n \in S PROVE n \in ReachableFrom(S)
SUFFICES ASSUME NEW S \in SUBSET Nodes, NEW T \in SUBSET Nodes, \A n \in S : Succ[n] \subseteq (S \cup T) PROVE (S \cup ReachableFrom(T)) = ReachableFrom(S \cup T)
SUFFICES ASSUME NEW n \in ReachableFrom(S) PROVE n \in S \cup ReachableFrom(T)
SUFFICES ASSUME NEW m \in S, NEW q \in Nodes, NEW p \in Seq(Nodes), /\ IsPathFromTo(p,m,q) /\ Len(p) = 0+1 PROVE q \in S \cup ReachableFrom(T)
ASSUME NEW i \in Nat, R(i) PROVE R(i+1)
SUFFICES ASSUME NEW m \in S, NEW q \in Nodes, NEW p \in Seq(Nodes), /\ IsPathFromTo(p,m,q) /\ Len(p) = (i+1)+1 PROVE q \in S \cup ReachableFrom(T)
SUFFICES ASSUME NEW S \in SUBSET Nodes, NEW n \in S PROVE /\ ReachableFrom(S) = ReachableFrom(S \cup Succ[n]) /\ n \in ReachableFrom(S)
SUFFICES ASSUME NEW m \in Succ[n], NEW o \in Nodes, ExistsPath(m, o) PROVE ExistsPath(n, o)
DivisionNotes: R is a local proof-internal operator (introduced via DEFINE inside the proof of Reachable1) and is placed in OperatorDefNames_ValueDef as a parameterized predicate-valued definition used purely as a proof induction hypothesis; it is also recorded in LocalOperatorNames.
All four lemmas (Reachable0, Reachable1, Reachable2, Reachable3) appear in TheoremNames as bare names since they are declared as named LEMMA statements.
TemporalNesting is false because this module has no temporal operators.
VerificationTools is TLAPS because this module is composed entirely of TLAPS-checked structured proofs (BY/QED/SUFFICES/PROOF, hierarchical step labels, NatInduction).
